RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot reliably assign a number from these facts

An all-male panel is worth noting, but it does not by itself establish sex bias. Your stronger academic credentials warrant asking how the published criteria were applied; industry experience might legitimately carry substantial weight.

Follow up in writing requesting the selection criteria, their weighting, feedback on your assessment, and the university’s panel-composition policy. Ask neutrally whether this panel complied with that policy.

Neither two weeks’ silence nor the announcement establishes discrimination. More telling evidence would include inconsistent criteria, sex-related comments, or departures from required procedures. Preserve correspondence and check complaint deadlines now with your union or an equality adviser; rules depend on your jurisdiction.
